definition: The President declares, continues, expands/modifies, or terminates an emergency legal status.
inclusion_rules: Operative text performs the emergency action or expressly continues a prior declaration.
exclusion_rules: Incidental emergency discussion; preparedness policy; IEEPA citation without an emergency-status action.

definition: The President blocks, freezes, or prohibits transfers of property or property interests.
inclusion_rules: Operative text imposes a blocking or freezing rule on property or interests in property.
exclusion_rules: General sanctions policy; asset reporting; seizure or forfeiture under a different mechanism.

definition: The President reserves or designates federal land or objects as a national monument.
inclusion_rules: Operative text proclaims, designates, reserves, enlarges, or modifies a national monument.
exclusion_rules: Commemorative monuments; parks or memorials not acted on through a monument designation.
